companies.name: Saudi Aramco
companies.summary: National oil company of Saudi Arabia. It produces the country's oil and gas, and it owns its refineries outright or with foreign partners.
companies.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: Saudi Arabia (2024)

companies.name: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
companies.summary: State oil company of Abu Dhabi. It runs most of the UAE's oil and gas industry, including the Ruwais refinery and the Das Island LNG plant.
companies.source: EIA Country Analysis Brief: United Arab Emirates (2026)

companies.name: Kuwait Petroleum Corporation
companies.summary: State oil company of Kuwait. Its subsidiaries include Kuwait Oil Company (the fields), Kuwait National Petroleum Company (the Mina Al-Ahmadi and Mina Abdulla refineries) and Kuwait Integrated Petroleum Industries Company (the Al Zour refinery).
